parameters.help_en: The cause of the modification failure.

parameters.name: dimension_value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型。  
当前支持集群（CLUSTER）和租户（TENANT）
parameters.name: dimension

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID of the parameter type.    
You can leave this parameter unspecified when you call this operation to modify cluster parameters. In the case of tenant parameters, pass the tenant ID.
parameters.help_zh:
参数信息。 其为一个 JSON 格式的数组，数组中每个对象包括两个元素：参数名称（Name）和参数值（Value）。
集群和租户可修改的参数名称和参数值的范围不同，详见 DescribeParameters
parameters.name: parameters

schema.description_en:
The parameters. It is a JSON array. Each object in the array has two elements: Name and Value.
The names and values of cluster parameters that can be modified are different from those of tenant parameters. For more information, see DescribeParameters.

RequestId.description_en:
The operation that you want to perform.   
Set the value to ModifyParameters.

Message.description_en: The message indicating why the modification failed
Message.title_en: You can call this operation to modify the parameters of a cluster or tenant.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the modification succeeded.  
true: The modification succeeded.  
false: The modification failed
